4. Locate monetary totals:

5. Verify no inference beyond visible data:
   - All extracted values are directly present in text. No fields are guessed or filled from context.

6. Decimal/format rules applied:
   - Kept same number of decimals as in source; converted comma decimal separators to JSON numeric format (dots).
